en: Black‑and‑white image showing a line of uniformed soldiers moving at double‑time along a dirt road in a pine forest. They wear early 20th‑century field uniforms with pickelhaube‑style spiked helmets, backpacks, ammunition pouches, and carry long rifles with fixed bayonets. The scene looks like a military exercise or march rather than active combat. There is no visible caption, border text, or postage marking on the front.
